answers.core: There are already addons for creating jiggle bones that fix this issue, but the built in SkeletonModification*DJiggle is already very close to being able to completely replace these.
answers.workaround: Yes, but doing so is is not trivial. Jiggle bones really should be something an artist can set up without programming knowledge.

title: Allow using SkeletonModification3DJiggle and SkeletonModification2DJiggle without a target
